digest.component_or_area: CLI/library surface for transition and claim commands
propositions: transition and claim must both accept --force[=<reason>] as the single unified CLI pattern, where the reason rides on --force and audit falls back to '(no reason given)' when bare
the transition library signature must change from force: bool + force_close: str to force: str | None, matching claim's canonical shape
legacy callers using transition(force=True) or transition(force_close=...) must warn via _deprecations and map to the new force string parameter
the in-memory spelling of the force-bypass reason must be unified to force_reason across transition and claim internals, while the persisted status_data['force_close_reason'] key remains unchanged
transition CLI must stop using --reason as a fallback for the force-bypass note; --reason feeds only close_reason, decoupling it from force
every guidance string in gates.py, txn.py, and transition.py must show only the --force[=<reason>] pattern with no transition --force --reason wording
